lines.text: What happened in Iowa today?
The US Army detonated bomb-making chemicals.
How far away was the smoke?
Smoke was seen from a mile away.
Who is helping right now?
CDC activated an emergency response to support Iowa.
Where can I read more?
Read our full story for the latest news.
